fields.text: Upload a tight product still; Google Nano Banana Edit (`nano-banana-edit`) outpaints a wider 16:9 hero (size `auto`, $0.039). First-click story is a tight/cropped matte-charcoal Volt pocket night-ride radio with one electric-cyan lightning-bolt chevron and hard cyan rim — this repo has no committed still, so upload that product photo or any tight catalog crop. This is canvas expand / outpaint only, not Muse Edit cleanup/bg replace (use Clean product photo), not H3 identity restyle, not Ideogram remove text, not BiRefNet cutout, not SAM 3 isolate, not P-Image Upscale (resolution only), not SeedVR2 / Clarity Crystal / other upscalers, not FLUX VTO, and not two-ref placement (use Product in a setting). 16:9 intent lives in the Outpaint brief (catalog lists aspect_ratio including 16:9; size is `auto` only). Catalog allows ≤4 input images; first-click uses one upload. nsfw: false. Inspect the native widened still; Export preview is a local 1024 fit only.

Outpaint / expand this tight crop into a wider 16:9 night-alley hero. Preserve the exact product shape, materials, markings, ONE electric-cyan lightning-bolt chevron, lighting, and camera angle of this matte-charcoal Volt pocket night-ride radio. Extend wet neon alley and dark slate only around the product. Do not restyle, recolor, invent props, logos, or a second product.
